svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Plate 59 x 25 x 3 mm, one end rounded to the collar's outside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 8.5 mm, 45 from the collar centre on the plate centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld the plate flat to the underside of the collar, pointing

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: away from the clamp bolt; keep the bore free of spatter.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the collar sits on the top headset cup with a 2 mm spacer,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its bolt clamps the steerer; the top cap and its bolt above

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: set the headset preload before the collar is tightened.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front: turn the collar so the hole lines up over the pin guide

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with the wheel trailing straight back; the pin drops in to lock.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rear: same, wheel straight ahead; the pin stays in, R-clipped.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: with the pin out the fork turns freely and does not knock.
